notes: This JSON summarizes ENSDF DECAY dataset headers into a decay graph: parent -> daughter with a decay mode hint.
It does NOT include full branching ratios, level-by-level cascades, or gamma line lists; those require parsing the full DECAY dataset body (P/D/L/G/B/E records).
Nuclide IDs follow ENSDF-style mass+element, e.g., 60CO.
